cases.name: seven-line CI timeout delta retains bounded independent challenge
cases.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/quality.yml b/.github/workflows/quality.yml
-    run: pytest tests/ --timeout=120
+    run: pytest tests/ --timeout=180
diff --git a/docs/ci-v2.md b/docs/ci-v2.md
-Tests have a 120 second budget.
-The previous value was too short.
+Tests have a 180 second budget.
+The runner has extra headroom.
+Keep this value aligned with CI.
